summary: Pop-culture / fandom collectibles that ship lightweight: Funko Pops (Star Wars, Marvel, DC, anime, exclusives), Hot Wheels collector variants (Star Wars, Treasure Hunts, Redlines, RLC), vintage Kenner Star Wars (1977-85), Topps trading cards. All small enough to ship in poly mailer or small box. Sweet spot: sealed/unopened Funko Pops $15-50, exclusive/chase Pops $50-300, vintage Kenner carded $50-500, vintage Hot Wheels Redlines $30-200.
field_workflow: Funko Pop: Verify the box is undamaged — collectors are pickier about box than figure
Funko Pop: Look for sticker — Convention (SDCC/NYCC), Chase, Funko Shop Exclusive, Hot Topic, etc. — these multiply value
Hot Wheels: TH (Treasure Hunt) / Super TH have green stripe / TH symbol on packaging; check for these markers
Vintage Kenner Star Wars: card grading (AFA/CAS) matters hugely; bubbles intact + clean back doubles value
Topps trading cards: factory-sealed boxes always > opened; verify wax-pack seal hasn't been tampered with
LEGO sets: 'retired' sets command 2-5x retail; verify sealed plastic on box hasn't been opened

era_markers: Funko branding on box top corner
Pop! number on box (e.g. #594 Luke Skywalker)
Sticker designation: Convention (SDCC/NYCC), Chase, Hot Topic, Funko Shop, Walmart Exclusive, etc.
Vinyl figure inside protective case (premium signal)
Original protective hard case ('Pop Stack' brand) adds resale
brands.notes: Funko Pop is the dominant modern pop-culture collectible. Box condition matters MORE than figure condition — many collectors buy sealed-in-package only. Convention exclusives + Chase variants are the resale champions. 'Vaulted' (retired) Pops appreciate steadily. Hard-shell protectors ('Pop Stack' / 'Pop Shield') signal serious collector ownership.

era_markers: Hot Wheels Treasure Hunt symbol (flame icon) on package
Super Treasure Hunt: gold-spectraflame paint + RR (real rider) tires
Redline tires (1968-77 vintage = 'Redlines') — colored stripe
RLC stamp (Red Line Club exclusive)
Original blister pack unopened (mainline) vs custom blister
Lesney era Matchbox (pre-1982 UK production)
brands.notes: Most Hot Wheels mainline (blue-card) is commodity at <$5. The premium tier is Treasure Hunts (TH), Super Treasure Hunts (STH), RLC exclusives, vintage Redlines (1968-77), and pop-culture variants (Star Wars / Marvel / Cars Culture). VINTAGE Lesney Matchbox (pre-1982 UK production) commands premium. Modern mainline blue-card Hot Wheels = skip.

era_markers: Kenner branding on cardback or box
Made in Hong Kong / Made in Macau / Made in China stamping
Backprint number identifies cardback era (12-back = 1978 first wave premium)
Original bubble intact + minimal corner wear
Star Wars logo era (1977-83) vs Empire / Return of the Jedi
Power of the Force coin (1985 final wave premium)

comp_ranges_usd.item: Power of the Force (1985) carded with coin
Vintage Kenner playset (Death Star, AT-AT, etc.)

brands.notes: Vintage Kenner Star Wars (1977-85) is the foundation of modern toy collecting. Carded (unopened) figures command 5-20x loose-figure prices. Cardback number (visible on back) identifies era — 12-back (1978 first wave) is premium. AFA / CAS grading adds 50-200%. Counterfeits of rare cardbacks exist; verify with Imperial Gunnery cardback database.

era_markers: Topps branding on packaging / card
Year on the front (e.g. '1987 Topps')
Factory-sealed wax pack vs broken box
Set seal: factory wrap intact = premium
Vintage 1950s-60s = highest premium era

comp_ranges_usd.item: Topps Heritage / Chrome modern hobby box
Topps Star Wars wax box vintage

brands.notes: Topps factory-sealed wax boxes are the resale gold for trading cards. Junk-wax era (1986-92) is mostly commodity unless packaging-mint. Vintage (1950s-60s) sealed packs trade at extreme premium. Star Wars Topps (1977-83) and Garbage Pail Kids (1985-88) vintage trade well. Always verify pack/box hasn't been searched.

era_markers: Loungefly logo embroidered on front strap or zipper
Hangtag with character licensing info (Disney, Marvel, etc.)
Faux-leather PU construction (signature Loungefly material)
Embossed/3D character details on front panel
Box Lunch / Hot Topic / Funko Shop / Disney Parks exclusive sticker
Loungefly serial / SKU on inside tag (LF-XXXXX format)

comp_ranges_usd.item: Box Lunch / Funko Shop exclusive Loungefly

brands.notes: IMPORTANT: Loungefly is the dominant maker of licensed-character mini backpacks (Disney, Marvel, Star Wars, Sanrio, Harry Potter, Pokemon, NBC). Auction listings often DON'T explicitly say 'Loungefly' — they just say 'Disney mini backpack' or 'Stitch backpack' or 'Marvel mini backpack'. We catch BOTH the explicit-brand listings AND the implicit ones via character + 'mini backpack' alias combinations. Retired / exclusive variants (Box Lunch, Funko Shop, Disney Parks-exclusive) trade 2-4x retail. Verify the Loungefly logo on strap or interior tag when listing — counterfeits exist (mostly cheap PVC knockoffs from import marketplaces).

era_markers: Hasbro stamping on Transformers (G1 = 1984-92)
Made in Japan stamp on G1 Transformers (Takara) = premium
Made in Hong Kong / Macau stamp on early G1
GI Joe ARAH (A Real American Hero) = 1982-94
MOTU (Masters of the Universe) = 1982-87 vintage
Mego = 1970s World's Greatest Superheroes line
brands.notes: G1 Transformers (1984-92), GI Joe ARAH (1982-94), and Masters of the Universe (1982-87) are the core 1980s vintage toy collector markets. Carded / sealed figures + complete playsets are the resale champions. Authentication risk for high-end pieces (G1 Optimus Prime); verify die-cast vs all-plastic, accessories complete.

platform_notes.eBay: Dominant marketplace for all pop-culture collectibles. Use sold-listings filter — asking prices are commonly 2-3x what items actually clear at.
platform_notes.Mercari: Funko Pops + Hot Wheels collector tier sell well at slight discount to eBay; lower fees offset.
platform_notes.Funko Europe: Reference for Funko exclusivity / Chase status — useful for confirming whether a box was a limited release.
platform_notes.Imperial Gunnery / Star Wars Cards: Reference databases for vintage Kenner Star Wars cardback identification + counterfeit detection.
